Hi everyone,

The CS182 JupyterHub Compute Portal is now live! 🎉
This will be your place to run course assignments with dedicated compute.

How to access:
You can find it from the course website’s navigation bar, or go directly here:
https://berkeley-cs182.github.io/jupyterhub/

What you get:

JupyterHub servers with CPU and GPU options

Login with your @berkeley.edu account

Compute options:

CPU (default): Use anytime for regular work

GPU (limited): Access to full NVIDIA A100 40GB. Use only during assigned time when needed for deep learning workloads

Group assignments:
Each student is assigned to Group A, B, or C. Check the portal to see where you're assigned. Slots will be continuously added, so check in regularly.

!!! IMPORTANT !!!

Only one team should run in a group server at a time

If you want to swap times with another team, coordinate in the thread below

Please shut down your server when you're done so others can use it 👍

If you run into issues or have questions, reply in the thread below or email me (pro@berkeley.edu).

Thanks and happy training!
Alex
